g.text: SCR05 — Callback subscriptions
Kotlin Compose screen definition · FR-CB-01 / 02 / 03 / 04 · blueprint2.0 design only
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled · 10
Phone390dp: Single-column scrolling data/detail and48dp controls; preserve explicit draft fields on rotation. Modal drawer below840dp; persistent rail
at840dp+. Back returns previous detail, with Discard/Stay for dirty drafts. Landscape: Same IDs and authorization; wide layout only when available
width>=840dp; never shrink protected actions below48dp.
SCR05.C01 · Inspect bounded status
Fields: Principal,phase,lease,delivery route,sequence,cursor bounds and cleanup disposition
Inspect selected subscription status without opening a backend registration
Failure: Unknown registration vs cleanup phase remains distinct; no replay
SCR05.C02 · Cancel via owner review
Fields: Exact handle/revision and verified cleanup plan; delivery closes before cleanup
SCR09 approves administrative cancellation of another client subscription
Failure: Cleanup failure records unknown; cannot promise backend unregister from timeout
SCR05.C03 · Open navigation
Fields: SCR01..SCR08,SCR10,SCR11; protected review only via exact command
Open all local destinations through phone drawer or wide rail; Back returns previous screen
Failure: Dirty draft requires Discard/Stay; navigation never commits configuration
SCR05.C04 · Select subscription
Fields: subscription_id,stream_epoch,client,backend and route
Select one owned/admin-visible handle and pin its current status revision
Failure: Foreign/expired handles deny; no payload leaks into status
SCR05.C05 · Read event page
Fields: Application cursor/offset, limits, explicit gap/terminal marker
Read finite authorized journal page or sealed frame/tree blob chunk
Failure: 410 shows retention boundary and offers current retained cursor; no reregistration
SCR05.C06 · Refresh status
Fields: Current subscription/stream lease expiry and cleanup state
Refresh status and delivery lease only; never renew or register implicitly
Failure: Death/revoke hides payload; uncertainty stays until supported reconciliation
SCR05.C07 · Review cleanup reconciliation
Fields: Recorded plan, endpoint generation, uncertain phase and new authority
Review safe reconciliation of an uncertain cleanup; execute only proven idempotent plan
Failure: No proof means inspect/forget delivery handle only; never repeat uncertain non-idempotent unregister
State definitions — exact enabled/disabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR05.S0 · Selected live callback subscription
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Show registration state, route=journal/direct, stream lease and cleanup phase.
Recovery: Read bounded retained events or request administrative cancellation.
SCR05.S1 · No registrations
Disabled: SCR05.C01, SCR05.C02, SCR05.C04, SCR05.C05, SCR05.C06, SCR05.C07
Effect: No selected handle or journal exists; page is empty, not failed.
Recovery: Return after an authorized client registers; UI never auto-registers.
SCR05.S2 · Cursor expired: retention boundary explicit
Disabled: SCR05.C05
Effect: Lost prefix not replayable; status and retained terminal/gap metadata still readable.
Recovery: Refresh status and explicitly restart from earliest retained cursor; no reregistration.
SCR05.S3 · Backend death/revoke/orphan: payload closed
Disabled: SCR05.C02, SCR05.C05
Effect: Registration or cleanup uncertainty is shown separately; handle durability is not OS registration.
Recovery: Inspect/reconcile only recorded verified cleanup; do not repeat uncertain effects.
SCR05.S4 · Delivery closed: cleanup disposition shown
Disabled: SCR05.C02
Effect: No new payload delivered; confirmed/unknown unregister remains explicit.
Recovery: Read retained terminal state; safe reconciliation only with current authority.
SCR05.S5 · Cleanup reconciliation has no safe retry proof
Disabled: SCR05.C02, SCR05.C05, SCR05.C07
Effect: No backend call is issued; unknown non-idempotent cleanup remains unknown.
Recovery: Retain evidence or forget only local delivery state after owner review; never claim unregister.
